countries.name: England
countries.headline: 1.26 million incidents dealt with by local authorities
countries.note: Excludes large-scale incidents dealt with by the Environment Agency and the majority of incidents on private land.

countries.name: Wales
countries.headline: 48,367 incidents reported by local authorities
countries.note: Reporting practices and data collection changes can affect year-on-year comparisons. Private-land incidents are under-recorded.

countries.name: Scotland
countries.coverage: National context; not a comparable annual council series
countries.headline: Around 26,000 tonnes fly-tipped each year
countries.note: At least £53 million of public money is spent on cleaning up litter and fly-tipping combined. Scotland does not currently have a complete, mandatory, nationally comparable annual local-authority incident series; the official baseline received primary data from 14 of 32 councils.

countries.name: Northern Ireland
countries.coverage: Reporting routes; no comparable launch series included
countries.headline: Councils handle ordinary incidents; NIEA handles serious waste crime
countries.note: The launch dataset does not present a Northern Ireland incident total as directly comparable with the England and Wales local-authority series.
